brief_rationale: This trajectory contains no in-chain serious or minor error. RC1–RC8 are all met, with explicit checking of current symptoms, high-risk framing, safe medication boundaries, identification of gaps, comorbidity awareness, concrete handoff plan, restraint from fabrication, and family teach-back. Multiple high-order opportunities were triggered and actively completed: HO1 corrected the misconception about IV nesiritide/furosemide being home injections, HO2 surfaced hidden facts (stent count, clopidogrel history, inpatient IV orders, transfer context) via workspace queries and targeted questions, HO3 verified ambiguous nurse-ordered drug lists and taught-back boundaries, and HO4 navigated rotating caregivers, shift logs, and cost/transport pressure. Each HO completed with meaningful trajectory impact. All five dimensions rated excellent. Closure is safe, executable, traceable, and valid. Therefore the trajectory meets all criteria for Grade 5 Perfect.
